Name: Pierre sells Loved crops
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Pierre sells Loved crops
Requirements: Content Patcher
This mod adds NPC's Loved crops to Pierre's store. You can choose to have the crops for sale by year or the season of the NPC's birthday.

Optional dialogue from Pierre, Caroline and Abigail.

********
Pumkin, Abigail & Willy, summer & fall
Pomegranate, Elliot, fall.
Truffle, Leah, winter.
Purple Mushroom, Wizard, winter.               
Coconut, Haley, spring.              
Cauliflower, Maru, summer.           
Strawberry, Demetrius, summer.                   
Cactus Fruit, Sam, summer.           
Melon, Penny, fall.  
Beet, Evelyn, winter.
Leek, George, fall.
Orange, Gus, summer. 
Wild Horseradish, Krobus, winter.           
Summer Spangle, Caroline, winter.                
Mango, Leo, summer.           
Hot Peppers, Lewis & Shane, spring.               
Yam, Linus, summer. 
Fairy Rose, Jas, summer.
Parsnip, Pam, spring.
Peach, Robin, fall.
SweetPea, Sandy, fall.               
Grape, Vincent, summer.
*******
The following NPC's do not have a Loved Crop
Alex, Harvey, Emily, Clint, Dwarf, Jodi, Kent, Marnie and Pierre.
***********

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿ (optional
but recommended)
4. Download and Extract [b]Pierre sells loved crops [/b]into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
5. Launch Stardew Valley. To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the
Stardew Valley title screen. 

[b]Dialogue
[/b]Dialogue is optional and works with my other mods. Most of the dialogue is new while some changes vanilla lines.

Do not use this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32020]Pierre's Grocery store [/url]or items will be doubled up. 
If you use Stardew Valley Expanded be sure to add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30329]Pierre sells Loved crops SVE

If you like this mod, take a look at some of my others, thanks
